title: Join the Tougelike Discord Server!
author: noz_
selftext:
Hey r/aigemdev \- some of you might remember the protype i posted about 2 months ago to the "[I'll rate your AI game](https://www.reddit.com/r/aigamedev/comments/1whzopm/ill_rate_your_ai_game/)" thread, that got alot of positive feedback - since then ive been working on it in my freetime and made it a proper rougelike with alot more complexity and polish - new 3d models, way more complex gameplay, more cars etc.

i would love to have some feedback and playtesters to find the missing gaps in it and improve it even further - the game is free and will remain free. just accessed via browser, works on any system, phones included. (small trick, if you are on your phone you can click the share button and then "add to home screen" you can play it fullscreen/landscape like a proper app. works on chrome desktop aswelll).

i also created a [discord](https://discord.com/invite/rX5sCHsW6j) to share more complex feedback and bugs, feel free to use but you can also keep it in this thread. Updates will instantly appear on the website and its changelog, but on the discord aswell with more details.

would love to know if you like and and what to improve! play it here: [https://njlent.de/tougelike/](https://njlent.de/tougelike/) 

because of the complexity of it, i also created an agent to activly builds a wiki for it [https://njlent.de/tougelike/wiki/](https://njlent.de/tougelike/wiki/) \- you can find out anything about the game and alot of its development inside there aswell. It also documents how the systems of the game were made and how they work with each other. Most of our time was spend playtesting and balacing it, but im sure there is alot that was missed.
